termMinMonths.note: CONFLICT: FAQ 'từ 6 - 36 tháng'; summary table and calculator say 3 - 60 months; the page's hidden JSON-LD says 6 - 60; the App Store listing (online channel) says 12 - 36. Stricter (narrower) FAQ range stored. See conflicts.

minPercent.note: Two minimums on the same page. Headline range, summary table, calculator footnote and the worked example all say 1.41%/month ('mức lãi suất ưu đãi tối đa dao động từ 1.41% đến 3.86%/tháng'). A general FAQ block on the same page says 'Khách hàng vay Tiền Mặt Linh Hoạt tại FE CREDIT với lãi suất ưu đãi giảm khoảng 40% so với thông thường, chỉ từ 1.67%/tháng'. Same tier, so the higher-cost 1.67 is stored (data-entry rules 6). If 1.41 is right, the borrower's cost is lower than shown. See conflicts.

maxPercent.note: Stated in the FAQ, the summary table ('Tối đa dao động từ 1.41% đến 3.86%/tháng (*)') and the calculator footnote ('Lãi suất dao động từ 1.41% đến 3.86%/tháng'). The page calls it a preferential rate ('ưu đãi'), 'tùy vào hồ sơ'. The page's hidden structured data (JSON-LD, not shown to users) says 2.08 - 5.49 %/month, so the true ceiling may be higher than 3.86. Page last modified 2026-10-22 (sitemap). See conflicts.

basis.note: The product page never states the basis. Two independent official worked examples fit FLAT arithmetic and not reducing balance: (1) web example 10M, 12 months, 1.41%/month gives 974.333/month, total 11.692.000; annuity at 1.41%/month would be about 911.700. (2) App Store / Google Play example 10M, 12 months, 28%/year gives 1.066.667/month, total 12.800.000 = 10M/12 + 10M x 28%/12; annuity at 28%/year would be about 965.100. The app text also says the rate is 'dựa trên dư nợ gốc' (based on principal debt). Contract templates for the sibling loans state a different monthly rate 'tính theo dư nợ giảm dần'; see conflicts. Flat stored as the costlier reading.

textVi.value: Nếu trễ hạn, bạn phải trả lãi trên nợ gốc quá hạn, tối đa 150% lãi suất trong hạn. Tiền lãi chậm trả bị tính thêm lãi, tối đa 10%/năm. Ngoài ra có thể bị phạt 8% số tiền liên quan đến điều khoản bạn vi phạm, nếu bạn vi phạm hợp đồng ở điểm khác ngoài việc trả chậm. Có phí phạt chậm trả: với tính năng Tiền mặt linh hoạt trên thẻ tín dụng, biểu phí thẻ ghi 100.000 hoặc 200.000 đồng tùy loại thẻ; với khoản vay thông thường FE Credit không công bố mức phí.
textVi.note: T&C 4.3.2, 4.3.3, 9.3.2 (effective 14/08/2026), re-read 2026-11-03. The 150% and 10%/year are ceilings ('không quá'). Contract templates (6.2.1): if the normal in-term rate is 0%, the base for overdue interest is 45% (unit not printed in the template). Card fee amounts come from the 05/11/2025 fee notices (low confidence, see fees).

overduePrincipalRateMultiplier.note: T&C 4.3.3: interest on overdue principal not above 150% of the in-term lending rate.

overdueInterestRatePercentYear.note: T&C 4.3.2: late interest on overdue interest not above 10%/year (365-day year).

representativeExamples.note: Product page FAQ example (also repeated in FE Credit's blog 'Top 11 app vay tiền nhanh' with the same figures): 10M, 12 months, 1,41%/month = 16,92%/year (1.41 x 12, nominal, NOT an effective APR), 974.000/month, total 11.692.000. Check: flat gives 10.000.000/12 + 141.000 = 974.333/month; 12 x 974.333 = 11.692.000 = the stated total exactly (12 x the rounded 974.000 = 11.688.000, a 4.000 VND rounding gap). Annuity at 1.41%/month would be about 911.700/month, so the example fits flat only. Our IRR check: about 2.49%/month, 29.9%/year nominal before the 12.000 collection fee per instalment. Insurance inclusion not stated.

App Store listing of FE ONLINE 2.0 (same text on Google Play): 'Số tiền vay 10.000.000 đồng; thời gian vay 12 tháng; lãi suất 28%/năm; khoản phải thanh toán hằng tháng 1.066.667 đồng; tổng số tiền phải thanh toán 12.800.000 đồng.' Check: 10.000.000/12 = 833.333 + 10.000.000 x 28%/12 = 233.333 gives 1.066.667; x 12 = 12.800.000. Fits flat only; annuity at 28%/year would be about 965.100. The basis is therefore inferred, the listing only says 'dựa trên dư nợ gốc'. Our IRR check: about 4.0%/month, 48.2%/year nominal, 60%/year effective (about 4.2%/month with the 12.000 per-instalment collection fee). Listing does not mention insurance.

Its footnote calls the result a rough reference ('mang tính chất tham khảo'). The '19.000.000 VND / 6.129 VND/ngày' shown in the page source is a server-rendered placeholder that the script overwrites on load, so it is not a real page bug. conflicts.resolution: Resolved 2026-11-02 (DECISIONS.md #19), evidence added 2026-11-03: not a contradiction. Advertised/FAQ rates are FLAT quotes (interest on the original amount); the contract states a different monthly rate on the reducing balance plus its yearly equivalent (Circular 39/2016 art. 13(3)). Both describe the same cost. The engine treats the advertised figure as flat and computes the real cost (IRR) from it. No published contract template for the cash loan itself states the monthly rate or basis; the cash page links only the FlexiMoney card agreements.

products.notes: 'Tiền mặt linh hoạt' is two things under one name. (a) The cash instalment loan (FE ONLINE 2.0 'khoản trả góp tiền mặt', cash out at collection points or into an Übank account) under the generic loan T&C. (b) The 'FlexiMoney - Tiền mặt linh hoạt' feature on a credit-card account, whose agreements are the only contract documents linked from this page (FlexiMoney NTB application and agreement); its approval letter states the rate in %/year on 365 days and the overdue fee follows the card fee schedule. We cannot tell which version a given borrower gets. The 19.000.000 VND / 6.129 VND per day on the page is a server-side placeholder that the calculator script replaces on load. FE ONLINE / FE ONLINE 2.0 is the app named on the page; the '$NAP' name is not verified as FE Credit's and is not used. Page last modified 2026-10-22 (sitemap).

borrowerNotes.vi: FE Credit gọi 3,86%/tháng là mức ưu đãi tối đa và chưa công bố mức thông thường, nên lãi suất thực tế có thể cao hơn. Sản phẩm có thể là khoản vay hoặc tính năng rút tiền trên thẻ tín dụng; hãy hỏi rõ trước khi ký.
borrowerNotes.en: FE Credit calls 3.86% a month its maximum preferential rate and hasn't published its standard rate, so your rate could be higher. This may be a loan or a cash feature on a credit card; ask before signing.

borrowerNotes.vi: Bảo hiểm là tự nguyện, bạn có quyền từ chối. Phí 1,5–7,99% khoản vay là khoảng chung cho các sản phẩm của FE Credit. Hãy kiểm tra ô mua bảo hiểm đã được đánh dấu sẵn hay chưa.
borrowerNotes.en: Insurance is voluntary and you can refuse it. The 1.5–7.99% of the loan is FE Credit's range across its products. Check whether the insurance box is already ticked.

FE Credit's campaign pages show 0% and low-rate programmes at partner dealers (for example 'Wave Alpha từ 0,39%' in Oct 2026), but the page describes no standing 0% programme.

researchNotes: Deep dive 2026-11-03. 1) Licensing: FE Credit is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id fe-credit, licence 69/GP-NHNN); legal name matches. 2) No loan rate table, biểu phí or 'công bố lãi suất' page exists for cash or installment loans (searched site sitemap, 1,297 URLs; fecredit.com.vn/cau-hoi/cac-loai-phi-phat/ redirects to the FAQ; web search found no FE Credit disclosure page). Only the credit cards have a published fee schedule (kept inside two 05/11/2025 fee notices). 3) Rate evidence by source. Product page (updated 2026-10-22): cash 'ưu đãi tối đa 1.41%-3.86%/tháng'. App Store and Google Play listing of FE ONLINE 2.0 (version 3.6.4, 2026-10-29): online cash loan 10-70 triệu, 12-36 months, 'từ 15% - 35%/năm ... dựa trên dư nợ gốc', worked example 10M/12m/28% = 1.066.667/month, total 12.8M (flat arithmetic). Hidden JSON-LD on the cash page: 2.08-5.49 %/month (not stored). General FAQ block: 'chỉ từ 1.67%/tháng'. New product Tiền Mặt Chủ Động: 'từ 20%/năm'. Old 2021 promo: 'từ 2,33%/tháng'. 4) Basis. Both cash examples (web 974.000 and app 1.066.667) are exactly flat arithmetic. The contract templates for motorbike (MB02), phone/electronics (MB01) and the insurance loan (MB03) state the contract rate as '%/tháng ... (tính theo dư nợ giảm dần)' with a yearly equivalent, while the FAQs say 'tính trên dư nợ ban đầu và cố định'. Recorded as the flat-quote vs contract-rate case (DECISIONS.md #19), not as a contradiction. No contract template for the cash loan itself is published; the cash page links only the FlexiMoney card agreements. The page calculators pay an annuity at hidden rates (25%, 27.44%, 45% a year) as a rough guide. 5) Fees. 12.000 VND collection fee per instalment is in T&C 5.3.3 and in all three contract templates. Early repayment: rate blank in every template; 8% of remaining principal is published only for the Flexi cash feature on JCB Plus and Góp Dễ cards (notices of 05/11/2025). Late fee: card schedule 100.000 / 200.000 VND; loan version unpublished. 6) Insurance is voluntary (page FAQ and MB03 art. III.5). Premium rate: 1,5% to 7,99% of the loan across credit products (blog 04/03/2026), about 1,5% (blog 30/09/2026); example 2,5% for a 6-month electronics loan. It may be paid at disbursement or financed by a separate insurance-premium loan (MB03) or spread over instalments (blog); not resolved. 7) The cash, motorbike and phone pages share one calculator widget and one site-wide FAQ, so the 1.41%-3.86% footnote appears on all three. That is why cash and phone looked identical; the product-specific FAQ figures differ (motorbike 0-5.7%, phone 0-2.69%, flat). 8) Other products not captured: FE Paylater (2,2% service/instalment fee, 5% overdue fee on closing balance, from the page), B@W, credit cards (fee schedules exist, not read in full). 9) Third-party pages (Viettel Store 2,33%/tháng, Di Động Việt 1,95%/tháng, a '21%' listing) are leads only. No official source states 21%. Old official 2021 promo: 'từ 2,33%/tháng'. 10) Late-penalty figures (150% ceiling, 10%/year ceiling, 8% breach penalty) were not compared against Circular 39 art. 13(4); a lawyer should check.
